ajay: kvtrace shows weird BW spike with tiled_pipeline on flashv2 A100, seq_len=2048, batch=4. nvprof attached. anyone seen sudden drop in mem throughput for tile=128?

devon: can you paste the nvprof lines? sounds like sharedmem thrash or bank conflicts.

ajay: ```
gpu: A100-sXM-40
kernel: flashv2_tiled_pipeline
tile: 64/128/256
seq=2048 b=4
nvprof: dram_throughput: 365.2 GB/s peak 741.3 GB/s
sm_eff: 0.72
sm_stall: 0.28
l1_hits: 12%
shared_mem_bank_conflicts: 18%
```

maria: interesting — with tile=64 we normally see ~610GB/s. 128 drops. did you enable pipeline stage 2 prefetch? maybe prefetch distance mismatched.

ajay: not explicitly. config snippet: `KERNEL_CONFIG={"tile":128,"pipeline_stages":2,"prefetch":1}`

perf-bot: auto-bench shows regression on flashv2_tiled_pipeline between commit abc123 -> def456: median p50 latency +12%, tokens/sec -9%, KV cache hits unchanged.

devon: suggestion: try raising occupancy by lowering smem usage (reduce per-thread tile_work) or try pipeline=3. e.g. run: `python perf/run_bench.py --model gpt2 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --kernel tiled_pipeline --tile 96 --pipeline 3` and collect `nvprof --metrics dram_read_throughput,sm_efficiency`.

maria: also compare fused_flash variant; fused often reduces shared mem pressure but watch register pressure. fused may win when shared_mem_bank_conflicts > ~10%.

ajay: quick sweep results: tile=96 pipeline=3 gives dram 605 GB/s, sm_eff 0.83, latency improved vs 128. mini table below.

ajay: | tile | stages | dram_GB/s | sm_eff |
ajay: | 64 | 2 | 612 | 0.86 |
ajay: | 96 | 3 | 605 | 0.83 |
ajay: | 128 | 2 | 365 | 0.72 |

infra-bot: pushed perf job at sha def456 with env `KV_CACHE=on PREFETCH=auto` — results uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/bench/1768882345 and dashboard at https://perf-console/redwood/1768882345

maria: we should add an occupancy-aware kernel selector in the runtime: if measured dram throughput < 500GB/s or shared_mem_conflicts>12% then prefer fused_flash; otherwise tiled. open a tiny heuristic PR?

devon: I'll prototype heuristic: if seq_len>1024 and batch<=8 and smem_per_warp > 48KB => prefer fused_flash; else tiled_pipeline with pipeline_stages tuned by occupancy target.

ajay: created issue #3421 with logs, flamegraphs, and nvprof output. assigning @devon @maria. thanks :thumbsup:

perf-bot: regression alert created: perf/regression/1768882345

ajay: follow-ups: (1) run full sweep on p3dn and p4 (2) add a KV-cache warmup trace to bench harness to rule out cold-kv interactions (3) test with quantized weights to see regs/smem change.

maria: agreed. i'll add kv-warmup flag to bench harness and a small flamegraph script to isolate bank conflicts.

devon: ping me when results land, i'll wire heuristic into kernel selector and add unit test for tile boundary cases.

ajay: thanks all, will post results here after p4 runs complete.
